_instructions: To add a new post: copy one of the post blocks below, paste it at the top of the 'posts' array, fill in the details, and create the matching HTML file in the /blog/ folder. The 'slug' must match the filename exactly (e.g. slug 'my-post' = /blog/my-post.html). Leave 'image' empty to show no image.

posts.title: Soft Gradient Lip Blush: Soft Centre, Blurred Border
posts.excerpt: The permanent version of cloud lips, blurred lips, and the bitten lip. A flush of colour at the centre that dissolves softly into the skin. No visible border, no liner, no daily reapplication. The lip blush style trending across Hollywood right now, with origins in Asian beauty.

posts.title: Ombré Lip Blush: The Defined Gradient Pout
posts.excerpt: The permanent version of overlined lips with a soft fill. A defined gradient border, a softer centre, and the structure of a perfectly drawn lip pencil without redrawing it every morning. From muted Pillow Talk nudes to healthy bright tones, with matte or glossy finish.

posts.title: Microblading vs Ombré Powder Brows: Which Is Right for You?
posts.excerpt: The most asked question at every consultation. The honest answer depends on your skin, your lifestyle, and the brows you want to wake up to. Here is how to decide between hair strokes, soft powder, or both.

posts.title: Microblading or Nano Brows: Which Suits You?
posts.excerpt: Two distinct techniques. One shared goal: brows that look effortlessly real. Understanding the difference helps you choose what is right for your skin, your lifestyle, and the result you are after.
